watch.homepageQuickActions: No separately labelled Watch control exists in Learning shortcuts.
watch.documentNavigationTradeoff: Native Watch navigation recreates transient JavaScript state, including the in-memory floating player.
watch.earlyFooterLimitation: A pointer held across an early streamed/lazy footer layout shift can release over moved content. Tests explicitly settle that layout before footer interaction.
watch.userDevice: Not supplied; actual physical-device session not matched.

featured.legacyPathFound: The inline HomeDashboard static hero rendered whenever featuredItems was empty. HomeHero.tsx is dormant; the shared static asset is retained for the unrelated Support page.
featured.cause: Empty curated data, including the original 1.2-second artwork deadline, could exhaust the DBZ-only fallback and enter the old hero branch.
featured.fix: Legacy branch removed. Current show cover or the same Featured frame handles failures. Exactly one Featured area; stable keys reset the carousel when rotation/admin edits change its pool.
featured.learnLinkedNote: This checkout supported Shows only; no existing Learn-targeted routing was removed.
featured.cache: Tagged catalogue/artwork caches and per-build Cloudflare KV prefix retained. Homepage HTML private/no-store. Manifest and recovery script revalidate. Live production HTML already used no-store; stale Cloudflare HTML was not established as the cause.

learn.history: Tables and admin note tools retained

performance.units: ms and bytes; medians of three fresh browser contexts per engine
performance.conditions: Next production build; synthetic backend; 390x844; analytics and YouTube blocked. Slow case injects 2500ms into Spotlight. Baseline read Featured after DOMContentLoaded; final polling starts at response commit to capture streaming.
performance.waterfallBefore: parallel catalogue/Spotlight/phrase -> wait for all -> home episodes -> Featured artwork -> render
performance.waterfallAfter: Independent reads start together; Featured streams independently; Spotlight discovery/player/transcript/metering start once near its viewport.
performance.auth: Homepage independent of role/session resolution. Pending Admin hidden. Server guards unchanged.

fonts.note: vinext 1.4.5 ignores localFont preload:false. Reading faces now use CSS @font-face/swap with original bytes. Only three UI faces register through next/font.

performance.images: Current production 828px curated AVIF verified at 46409 bytes. Responsive artwork/crop unchanged; browser tests verify one mounted slide image. Synthetic fallback artwork bytes are not representative production images.
limits: WebKit isolated JS CPU time and hydration duration unavailable; React commit/hydration completion timestamps recorded instead.
Usable interaction measures menu opening after Featured appears, not a standardized TTI score.
No production after-deployment samples; nothing deployed.

watch.units: ms and bytes; three fresh contexts per browser; same synthetic Next production server

performance.normalTimingConclusion: Normal paint/Chrome interaction timings are roughly flat or slightly slower. Slow Spotlight no longer blocks Featured. WebKit interaction time improved. No production after-deployment measurement.

installedApp.metadata: Added Apple capable/title/status-bar metadata and theme color
installedApp.serviceWorker: None in current source or fresh browser profiles; no worker introduced
installedApp.caching: No cached offline HTML shell or mixed-build navigation fallback. Existing physical installations uninspected.
installedApp.offline: Reconnect/reload notice on an existing page. First offline navigation uses the browser network-error experience; no full offline support.
installedApp.chunkFailure: Independent recovery script offers manual reload, with no automatic loop
installedApp.auth: Signed-out, signed-in, expired-token refresh, reload/history and simulated resume pass
installedApp.physicalIphone: BLOCKED: no physical iPhone or Safari device. Actual Home Screen install and OS process restart not tested.
